note: Expectations for `ta-agent discover` on tests/fixtures/discover_uca_sample.csv (a synthetic, messy university list), captured from a live run on 2026-11-25 against the local Neo4j holding ESCO, O*NET, SFIA, BLS and JobTech (policy discover-v1, depth 2, breadth 4). Structure and determinism are asserted, not exact counts, so a taxonomy reload that adds nodes does not fail them. Connectors that reach the items only through a tool (O*NET USES_SOFTWARE) are `tool_only` and rank last (ADR-0012). expect_resolved_in lists suites an item must resolve in at least (clear label matches only). expect_never_resolved are items no taxonomy has a label for: auto-picking any of them is a regression (Locate's meaning-only hits must stay unclear). expect_guess lists the allowed verdicts per guess.
